text: Why Study MBBS in Nankai University -- A Pioneer in International Education -- Located in Tianjin, just 30 minutes to Beijing -- Validated and quality-assured by the World Health Organisation Laboratory facilities at Nankai University Nankai University laboratories allow the delivery of a wide range of practical classes in the biological sciences; complementing the information derived from other teaching sessions, as well as giving direct experience of experimental and diagnostic techniques. Main Courses Regional Anatomy, Histology & Embryology, Medical Biochemistry, Cell Biology,Innovation Research & Training, Pathology, Pharmacology, Diagnostics, Epidemiology, Medical Ethnics, Operative Surgery, Paediatrics, Infectious Diseases etc. Study Duration 6 years; 40 hour learning week with 20 hours contact teaching per week Study Location Years 1 - 4: Nankai University, Tianjin Years 5 - 6: Clinical placement in a leading Chinese hospital Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Medicine
